column1: # Model Card: House Price Prediction System
This project builds a house price prediction system using supervised regression machine learning.
Estimate the price of a property based on property characteristics.
The dataset is loaded with Pandas and cleaned before training.
- Convert numeric fields to numeric type
- Fill numeric missing values with median
- Fill categorical missing values with most frequent value
The best model is selected based on the highest R² value
